result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a wide, continuous concrete sidewalk separated from the roadway by a standard curb. However, the area is characterized by car-centric land use with large parking lots, blank frontages, and a lack of pedestrian-scale buffers or marked crossings near the visible transit stop.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions

interventions.description: Implement traffic calming measures such as speed humps or cushions to maintain lower vehicle speeds on this residential block.
